data.headline: Nvidia Stock vs. Taiwan Semiconductor Stock: Billionaire Ken Griffin Buys One and Sells the Other
data.summary: Interestingly, while Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Taiwan Semiconductor (NYSE: TSM) are both positioned to benefit from demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, Griffin bought one stock and sold the other in the third quarter.  Nvidia: Griffin bought 4.7 million shares, increasing Citadel's position by 194%.  Taiwan Semiconductor: Griffin sold 135,556 shares, trimming Citadel's stake by 7%.
